import{useState}from'react';import{useAuthContext}from'./useAuthContext';export const useSignup=()=>{const[error,setError]=useState(null);const[isLoading,setIsLoading]=useState(null);const{dispatch}=useAuthContext();const signup=async(email,password)=>{setIsLoading(true);setError(null);const response=await fetch('http://localhost:4000/api/user/signup',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({email,password})});const json=await response.json();console.log(json);if(!response.ok){//Error - show error to user
setError(json.error);// or console.log(json.error)
setIsLoading(false);}else{//Success - user signed up
localStorage.setItem('user',JSON.stringify(json));dispatch({type:'LOGIN',payload:json});setIsLoading(false);}};return{signup,isLoading,error};};
